column1: Purpose: Log your ad spend and call numbers once per day, so when something does not work, you know exactly where the problem is.
1. Fill in one row per day for the yellow columns. Ad Spend and Outbound Clicks come straight from Ads Manager.
2. Keep Qualified Calls Attended separate from Calls Attended. Ten calls with people who can buy is very different from ten calls with people who cannot.
3. The blue columns calculate themselves. Close Rate is Clients Acquired divided by Calls Booked.
4. The purple Week row and red Month row add up the yellow columns, then calculate the blue columns from those totals. Do not type into them.
